نستحم (form X)
# نَسْتَحِمُّ (nastaḥimmu) /nas.ta.ħim.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَحَمَّ (istaḥamma)
# نَسْتَحِمَّ (nastaḥimma) /nas.ta.ħim.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحَمَّ (istaḥamma)
# نَسْتَحِمِّ (nastaḥimmi) /nas.ta.ħim.mi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَحَمَّ (istaḥamma)
